title: There can be only one! FEMALE GAMETOPHYTE GUARD and OsERECTA2 ensure only 1 archesporial cell for proper embryo sac development
content: Rice is a staple in the diet for more than half of the human population worldwide, and its yield relies on normal development of the embryo sac (female gametophyte). However, our knowledge of the molecular mechanisms underlying embryo sac development is quite scarce due to its hidden nature inside the ovule and limited cytological and omic analyses.
